name: Urban Hyperspectral Scene Dataset
description: A dataset and benchmark for urban scene understanding using hyperspectral images, measuring land-cover classification and scene parsing performance in urban environments.
reputation: A niche but valuable dataset within the hyperspectral remote sensing community for urban scene understanding, cited in specialized remote-sensing research.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; hyperspectral data can be small and domain-specific, with spectral variability and sensor differences limiting generalization; potential for dataset bias toward certain urban types.
